# hyperfluid_alert_matrix_bot (Data Source)

Look up a Matrix alert bot by name, e.g. to name it from a `matrix` alert channel managed elsewhere. Needs the organization's `alerting_enabled` feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperfluid_alert_matrix_bot" "tchap" {
  name = "tchap-alerts"
}

output "tchap_bot_phase" {
  value = data.hyperfluid_alert_matrix_bot.tchap.phase
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Bot name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `allow_unencrypted_rooms` (Boolean) Whether the bot may post into a room that is not end-to-end encrypted.
- `device_id` (String) The Matrix device the bot lives on.
- `homeserver_url` (String) The homeserver of a `generic` bot.
- `id` (String) Bot id, named by a channel's `matrix.bot_id`.
- `message` (String) What the phase is about.
- `phase` (String) Where the bot's notifier stands.
- `preset` (String) `tchap` or `generic`.
- `relogin_required` (Boolean) The bot's session ended and it must log in again.
- `user_id` (String) The bot account's MXID.
